description: This file defines the GameState class which manages the state, scoring, and persistence for a Tic Tac Toe game in a Flutter application. It includes methods for handling moves, resetting the game, detecting winners/draws, and persisting scores using shared_preferences.

classes.name: GameState
classes.description: A ChangeNotifier class that manages the Tic Tac Toe game state, including the game board, current player, scores, move logic, winner detection, and persistence of scores.

methods.name: _loadScores
methods.description: Asynchronously loads scores from shared preferences.

methods.name: _persistScores
methods.description: Saves current scores to shared preferences.

methods.name: playMove
methods.description: Attempts to play a move at the specified index, updates the game state accordingly, and notifies listeners.

methods.name: resetBoard
methods.description: Resets the game board for a new round without resetting scores.

methods.name: resetScores
methods.description: Resets both players' scores to zero and resets the board.

methods.name: detectWinner
methods.description: Checks the current board for a winner and updates state accordingly.

methods.name: detectDraw
methods.description: Checks for a draw condition when all moves are used without a winner.

methods.name: _detectWinner
methods.description: Internal method to determine if a player has won the game based on the current board.

methods.name: _detectDraw
methods.description: Internal method to set the game as a draw if all cells are filled without a winner.
